import re
thread_ids=[47827,47823,47821]
threads_data={}
for tid in thread_ids:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    threads_data[tid]=th
    print('\n=== Thread', tid, 'subject:', th.get('label'), th.get('created_at'))
    print('Top email subject:', th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('subject') if th.get('emails') else None)
    # print preview of bodies
    if th.get('emails'):
        body=th['emails'][0].get('body','')
        print('Body length', len(body))
        # extract potential promo codes
        # Look for patterns like 'code' followed by alphanumerics
        candidates=set()
        for m in re.finditer(r'(?i)(?:promo\s*code|use\s*code|code)\s*[:\-]?\s*([A-Z0-9]{4,})', body):
            candidates.add(m.group(1))
        # also any all-caps alphanum sequences of length 4-10
        for m in re.finditer(r'\b[A-Z0-9]{5,10}\b', body):
            s=m.group(0)
            if any(c.isdigit() for c in s) and any(c.isalpha() for c in s):
                candidates.add(s)
        print('Promo code candidates:', sorted(candidates)[:10])
        print('Body sample:', body[:400].replace('\n',' ') )
    else:
        print('No emails in thread')

import re

# Pull promo code from the promo email thread we already fetched
new_promo_code = None
if 'threads_data' in globals() and 47823 in threads_data:
    th = threads_data[47823]
    # Extract from first email body
    if th.get('emails'):
        body = th['emails'][0].get('body','')
        # Look for 'Your Promo Code => CODE'
        m = re.search(r'(?i)promo code\s*=>\s*([A-Z0-9]{4,})', body)
        if m:
            new_promo_code = m.group(1)
        else:
            # fallback: first all-caps alnum block with mixed letters+digits length>=4
            cands = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z0-9]{4,}\b', body)
            new_promo_code = cands[0] if cands else None

print('Extracted promo code from email:', new_promo_code)

# Re-check current cart totals
cart_old = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
old_total = cart_old['total_cost']
old_promo = cart_old['promo_code']
old_valid = cart_old['promo_valid']
print('Cart with existing promo:', old_promo, 'valid', old_valid, 'total_cost', old_total)

# Apply new promo code and re-check cart totals
if not new_promo_code:
    raise RuntimeError('Could not extract new promo code')

apply_resp = apis.amazon.apply_promo_code_to_cart(promo_code=new_promo_code, access_token=amazon_token)
print('apply_promo_code_to_cart response:', apply_resp)

cart_new = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
new_total = cart_new['total_cost']
new_promo = cart_new['promo_code']
new_valid = cart_new['promo_valid']
print('Cart after applying new promo:', new_promo, 'valid', new_valid, 'total_cost', new_total)

# If promo didn't apply, try removing then applying once
if (not new_valid) or (new_promo != new_promo_code):
    rem_resp = apis.amazon.remove_promo_code_from_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
    print('remove_promo_code_from_cart response:', rem_resp)
    apply_resp2 = apis.amazon.apply_promo_code_to_cart(promo_code=new_promo_code, access_token=amazon_token)
    print('apply_promo_code_to_cart (after removal) response:', apply_resp2)
    cart_new = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
    new_total = cart_new['total_cost']
    new_promo = cart_new['promo_code']
    new_valid = cart_new['promo_valid']
    print('Cart after re-applying new promo:', new_promo, 'valid', new_valid, 'total_cost', new_total)

# Decide cheaper option
if old_total <= new_total:
    chosen_promo_code = old_promo
    chosen_total = old_total
    chosen_label = 'existing'
else:
    chosen_promo_code = new_promo_code
    chosen_total = new_total
    chosen_label = 'new_email'

print('Chosen:', chosen_label, 'promo_code:', chosen_promo_code, 'total_cost:', chosen_total)

# Persist for later
promo_comparison = {
    'old_promo_code': old_promo,
    'old_total_cost': old_total,
    'new_email_promo_code': new_promo_code,
    'new_total_cost': new_total,
    'chosen_promo_code': chosen_promo_code,
    'chosen_total_cost': chosen_total,
}
print('promo_comparison:', promo_comparison)

cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cards', cards)

# Determine valid cards by (year, month) >= current
valid=[]
for c in cards:
    exp_y = int(c.get('expiry_year'))
    exp_m = int(float(c.get('expiry_month')))
    valid_flag = (exp_y, exp_m) >= (now.year, now.month)
    valid.append((c['payment_card_id'], c.get('card_name'), exp_y, exp_m, valid_flag))
print('valid flags', valid)

# pick card with latest expiry among valid
valid_cards=[c for c in cards if (int(c.get('expiry_year')) , int(float(c.get('expiry_month')))) >= (now.year, now.month)]
print('valid_cards', valid_cards)

if not valid_cards:
    raise RuntimeError('No unexpired cards found')

# choose max expiry
best = sorted(valid_cards, key=lambda c: (int(c.get('expiry_year')), int(float(c.get('expiry_month')))))
